metadata.domain: Autonomous Driving Platform / ADAS / Automotive Electronics

evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL 6→completion in 2 years) and T03 (TRL 7) are reasonable, but T03's roadmap shows a 0-quarter development window (2030-Q1→2030-Q1), which is infeasible for any real engineering work, and T08 requires a TRL 5 system to advance through 2 years which is optimistic but not impossible.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared 기술선도 strategy calls for lower-TRL exploratory technologies and R&D-heavy portfolio, but the selected technologies are relatively mature (TRL 5-7) and lean toward near-market commercialization; only T08 at TRL 5 reflects genuine exploration, making the portfolio a mixed signal.
evidence.competitive_awareness: There is no visible evidence of competitor positioning, differentiation rationale, or timing advantages designed relative to competitors in the roadmap; technology selections appear driven by internal dependency chains rather than competitive landscape intelligence.
evidence.market_timing: For 기술선도, technologies should complete 1-2 years before market boom; instead, all three technologies complete after their respective boom windows (errors of 0.75yr, 2.25yr, and 2.0yr respectively), with T08 and T03 missing their windows by over 2 years, which is penalized under both strategies.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies (sensor fusion, 3D pose estimation, steer-by-wire) are all active areas with both patent and market activity in autonomous driving, suggesting some convergence awareness, but there is no explicit evidence of deliberate convergence-zone targeting in the selection rationale.

strengths: Dependency chain is correctly structured and violation-free (T01→T08→T03), ensuring logical technology progression
Budget is fully utilized with zero violation, indicating disciplined financial planning
weaknesses: Systematic post-boom completion across all three technologies means the portfolio misses its market windows, undermining both strategic leadership and ROI
스테어 바이 와이어 제어 has a zero-duration development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), making its execution plan physically infeasible
missing_technologies: LiDAR-based HD mapping (lower TRL, high patent activity, aligns with 기술선도 at earlier market entry)
AI-based end-to-end driving policy networks (TRL 3-4, highly exploratory, appropriate for technology leadership strategy)
V2X communication middleware (complementary to sensor fusion, with earlier boom window enabling preemptive positioning)
investment_issues: All technologies are classified as Strategic or High tier despite two of them (T08, T03) having significant post-boom timing errors, suggesting tier assignments do not adequately penalize timing risk
스테어 바이 와이어 제어 (TRL 7, lower uncertainty score of 2.0) receives High-tier investment but its zero-duration roadmap and post-boom completion make it a poor candidate for premium investment allocation
timing_issues: 3D 포즈 추정 시스템 completes in 2030-Q1 but market boom was 2027-Q4 — a 2.25-year post-boom miss that eliminates first-mover advantage
스테어 바이 와이어 제어 completes 2 years after its 2028-Q1 boom, arriving as market commoditization is likely underway
Even T01 (the best-timed technology) completes 0.75 years after boom, missing the 기술선도 ideal of 1-2 years before boom
